infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: AquaNode uses Bluetooth to discover and provision ESP32 water quality devices.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location is required on some Android/iOS versions for Bluetooth scanning during device setup.
